meta.title: Romullo Sousa · Software Engineer
meta.description: Software Engineer full stack, com foco em Front-end e interesse crescente por aplicações com IA.

hero.bio1: Há quase 10 anos construindo software para a web, resolvendo desafios complexos e explorando novas tecnologias pelo caminho.
hero.bio2: Gosto de entender como as coisas funcionam e, principalmente, <hl>transformar ideias em coisas que funcionam de verdade</hl>.
hero.photoAlt: Retrato em preto e branco de Romullo Sousa

about.paragraph1: My story with development started before it became a career. I've always loved exploring technology, understanding how things work, and building my own projects. That curiosity is what led me into software development, and it's still a big part of what drives me today.
about.paragraph2: I started out professionally building web applications and, over time, <hl>Front-end</hl> became my main area of expertise. But I never stayed locked into a single layer. Working across different products and teams naturally led me into <hl>Back-end</hl>, <hl>databases</hl>, <hl>cloud</hl>, <hl>infrastructure</hl>, and other parts of the development cycle.
about.paragraph3: Outside of work, I'm still that dev who likes to experiment. <hl>Open Source</hl>, <hl>Linux</hl>, <hl>mobile</hl>, <hl>WebAssembly</hl>, <hl>CLIs</hl>, and <hl>developer tooling</hl> have all been part of those projects. I also have a soft spot for <hl>UI/UX and DX</hl>, always trying to balance good experiences with <hl>quality, security, and simplicity</hl> in what I build.
about.paragraph4: More recently, that same curiosity has led me toward <hl>AI applied to software</hl>, exploring <hl>LLMs</hl>, <hl>agents</hl>, <hl>RAG</hl>, <hl>MCP</hl>, and <hl>local models</hl>, both within products and in the development process itself.
about.paragraph5: In the end, I like technology, but I like <hl>building things, learning along the way, and solving problems that make me think</hl> even more.

items.description: Construção e evolução de produtos para o ecossistema de Justiça, com foco em aplicações web. Trabalhei na modernização de sistemas legados, desafios de performance, expansão internacional e, mais recentemente, em iniciativas envolvendo IA generativa, OCR e processamento de documentos.

Desenvolvimento de produtos SaaS do Front-end à produção, passando por Back-end, bancos de dados, AWS e deploy. Entre eles, uma plataforma de fidelização construída do zero que chegou a mais de 500 clientes em 12 estados.
